before.content:
./gradlew :ji-relay-protocol:test :ji-relay-server:test :ji-host-core:test :ji-host-sqlite:test :ji-host-web:test --offline --no-daemon
corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' test
corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' build
docker compose -p ji-relay -f deploy/relay/compose.yaml config --quiet
if [ -n "${JI_RELAY_BOOTSTRAP_FILE:-}" ]; then
  ./scripts/verify-stage5-ubuntu-compose.sh
fi
printf '%s\n' STAGE5_GATE_OK

after.content:
./gradlew :ji-relay-protocol:test :ji-relay-server:test :ji-host-core:test :ji-host-sqlite:test :ji-host-web:test --offline --no-daemon
corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' test
corepack pnpm --filter '@ji/web-app' build
if [ "$(uname -s)" != Linux ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Stage 5 Compose verification must run on the authorized Ubuntu host' >&2
  exit 2
fi
./scripts/verify-stage5-ubuntu-compose.sh
printf '%s\n' STAGE5_GATE_OK
